meta.name: ViralPilot
meta.description: Source-derived profile of the implemented warm creator studio; no image color measurement is claimed.

neutral.usage: Warm light backgrounds to dark readable ink; muted text uses #60725F.

color.contrast_strategy: Dark on light; labels and numbers complement color. Essential data uses opaque surfaces.

font_families.heading: Instrument Serif
font_families.mono: browser monospace for code examples only

typography.font_style_notes: Self-hosted editorial serif with selective italics; humanist sans for metrics, controls and reading.

spacing.content_density: comfortable, denser within related metric groups
spacing.section_rhythm: Large editorial openings; grouped app controls and report sections

layout.grid_system: Responsive CSS grid and flex; projected 960x540 story coordinate space
layout.columns: Multiple columns on desktop, single-column app on mobile
layout.alignment_tendency: Centered cinematic focal point; left-aligned functional reading

shape.border_usage: Subtle one-pixel neutral separators and bright glass edges

levels.high: Overlapping analytics and central glass lens

motion.entrance_pattern: Staged two-part transform with small overshoot
motion.philosophy: Cinematic narrative with deterministic reversibility; functional app feedback is restrained

components.button_style: Forest action, warm white text, 9px corners, visible focus
components.input_style: Native semantics, neutral borders, explicit validation
components.card_style: Light opaque data surfaces with restrained borders
components.navigation_pattern: Translucent hero pill, solid app header, mobile menu
components.list_style: Named, actionable timestamp and opportunity rows
components.component_notes: Keyboard tabs; numeric chart labels; copy confirmation; visible demo labels

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Entering a quiet room and gathering fragmented tools
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary editorial software and architectural visualization

visual_language.ornamentation: Purposeful physical objects and glass highlights
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous around statements; economical within reports
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Scene first, then readable monitor, then functional studio
visual_language.texture_usage: Photographic wood, realistic plant textures, metal, procedural fabric

composition.balance_type: Centered focal monitor with asymmetric desk objects
composition.flow_direction: Room depth into screen; vertical application flow

imagery.photo_treatment: Natural morning light and atmospheric mountain depth
imagery.graphic_elements: Retention paths, comparison bars and glass contours
imagery.image_shape: Architectural frame; no decorative image masking

interaction_feel.loading_style: Clearly labeled cancellable demo stages or real upload progress
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Low in app; deliberate narrative motion

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Explain next action and offer sample

overview.fallback_strategy: Current scene capture plus HTML story; reduced motion uses unpinned still and studio

background_effects.description: Real modeled workspace with original generated landscape plate outside window

params.speed: Camera follows scroll; subtle plant sway

particle_systems.description: No particles; no unbounded notification spawning

3d_elements.description: Licensed hardware, plants and lamp with original room/accessories

params.lighting: HDRI, directional sun, initialized rectangular window light, two one-time contact shadows
params.camera: Early close approach; imported monitor tilt accounted for
params.materials: PBR, photographic maps, physical sheen and weave bump
params.geometry: Licensed GLB hardware; instanced sculpted keys; Meshopt compressed
params.interaction_model: Single scroll playhead and HTML homography

shader_effects.description: Restrained edge darkening; localized SVG caustic displacement

params.distortion: Local caustic only; essential text excluded

scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: Camera, windows, graphs, notifications and glass

scroll_morphing.description: Asymmetric panel convergence, Bezier contour morph and continuous monitor-to-viewport projection

text_effects.description: Whole readable captions; no letter scramble

image_effects.description: Natural textured assets; fallback image only softens as HTML story begins

params.reveal_animation: Scene loads behind already available fallback

params.transparency: Neutral translucent panels, strongest during convergence
params.border_treatment: Fine white edge and SVG gradient contour

params.animation_loop: Active only while scene is visible

svg_animations.description: Retention graph stroke reveal, bar growth and glass Bezier interpolation

params.filter_effects: Turbulence + displacement + blur on decorative caustic only

visual_effects.composite_notes: The exact source files remain authoritative. Values described as responsive/component-specific are deliberately not invented fixed tokens. No full-backdrop SVG URL filter is used because Chromium clipped the projectively transformed interface.
